anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: The Spirit searches the depths of God.

choices.why: The Word hidden in the middle if the head is deity.

pass_a_gloss: And those chewing the inwards, laboring, these will also see the depths of God — for the inwards have some intricate folding and work the whole living for the body; such also is the one being initiated in mysteries — or rather the Word of the becoming-human, hidden and as it were into the middle, if at least we should take the head as the godhead.
pass_b_english: And those who chew the inwards, laboring at it, these will also see the depths of God — for the inwards have a kind of intricate folding and effect the whole life of the body. Such also is the one being initiated in mysteries. Or rather, the Word of the incarnation, hidden and as it were in the middle — if we should take the head as the godhead.
source_text: οἱ δὲ τὰ ἐντοσθίδια τρώγοντες φιλοπονοῦντες οὗτοι ὄψονται καὶ τὰ βάθη τοῦ θ(εο)ῦ – τὰ γὰρ ἐντοσθίδια συνείλησίν τινα ἔχει πεποικιλμένην καὶ τὴν ὅλην ζῶσιν τῷ σώματι ἐργάζεται· τοιοῦτος καὶ ὁ ἐν μυστηρίοις μυούμενος – ἤγουν τὸν ἀποκεκρυμμένον καὶ οἷον εἰς μέσον τόν τῆς ἐνανθρωπήσεως λόγον, εἴ γε κεφαλὴν τὴν θεότητα λάβοιμεν·
